summary: Iteration 4 testing complete. Backend: 57/58 pytest passed across all suites (19 new iter-4 + 40 regression) — 1 critical RBAC failure. Frontend: 5-tab admin layout verified (Home/Users/Payouts/Txns/More). /admin/more, /admin/orders, /admin/audit render with full testID coverage. /admin/home is stuck on an infinite loading spinner when the analytics call doesn't succeed (silent catch + loading-gate bug); KYC / quick-action UI could not be visually verified through this code path.

critical.issue: RBAC not enforced — endpoint uses require_admin (line 702 of server.py) instead of require_admin_role('super_admin'). A 'manager' admin (role=admin, admin_role=manager) successfully updated settings and got 200 OK. Helper `require_admin_role` is defined at server.py:142 but is NEVER called anywhere. Other admin endpoints (users, kyc, withdrawals, orders, txns, audit) correctly use require_admin so manager/support can access — that part works. Only settings RBAC is missing.
critical.fix_hint: Change the dependency on PUT /admin/settings to `Depends(require_admin_role('super_admin'))` and add an explicit 403 message. Optionally also gate POST /admin/products if intended.

ui_bugs.issue: Page is stuck on ActivityIndicator forever if `/api/admin/analytics` fails for any reason (e.g., token not yet bootstrapped, network blip, 401). Root cause: `try { ... } catch {}` swallows the error silently AND the render gate `if (loading || !data) return <Spinner />` keeps spinner on screen because `data` stays null. Reproduced by directly navigating to /admin/home; saw 401 in console followed by infinite spinner. Quick-action buttons (qa-kyc/qa-orders/qa-audit/qa-settings), KPI cards (kpi-new-today/...), period tabs, charts and hero card all become unreachable in this state.
ui_bugs.fix_hint: Render an error UI with a Retry button when the API fails. Also wait for auth bootstrap before firing the first request, OR have the api client retry once after auth restoration.

integration_issues.issue: Login.tsx has `if (u.role === 'admin') router.replace('/admin/home')` — code path looks correct; navigation lands on /admin/home, but because of the spinner bug above the user sees a blank loading screen on a fresh session. Admin layout's bottom 5 tabs (Home/Users/Payouts/Txns/More) are fine.

issues: Pre-existing carry-over warning: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` (RN web).

react_native_issues.issue: Expo doctor reports react-native-svg@15.15.4 vs expected 15.12.1 for current Expo SDK. Bar charts on /admin/home use it; not verified at runtime due to spinner bug. Consider `npx expo install react-native-svg` to resolve.

action_items: [CRITICAL] Apply require_admin_role('super_admin') dependency to PUT /api/admin/settings. Verify 403 for managers, 200 for super_admin.
[HIGH] Fix /admin/home AdminHome: surface API errors instead of swallowing, and render an error/retry UI when analytics fails. Optionally delay first call until auth.user is hydrated.
[MEDIUM] Run `npx expo install react-native-svg` to align with Expo SDK (15.12.1).
[LOW] server.py is now ~1342 lines — long-overdue split into routers (admin/, kyc/, orders/, settings/).
[LOW] Carry-over: replace deprecated `props.pointerEvents` with `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:142 defines `require_admin_role(*allowed)` but it is unused project-wide — dead code that gives a false sense of RBAC. Wire it into PUT /admin/settings (and any super-admin-only endpoint).

admin/home.tsx:39-45 has `try { ... } catch {}` then `setLoading(false)`; if the request fails, the page enters a permanent spinner because `if (loading || !data) return <Spinner/>` short-circuits on null `data`. Either keep `loading` true on error OR gate on `error` separately so users see a retry button.
Backend `_audit_log` is auto-fired by every admin write — good. But /admin/audit-logs has no pagination cursor; only `limit` is supported. Consider `?before=<created_at>` for scrollback.

/admin/transactions/{id}/refund refunds `abs(amount)` regardless of original txn direction — refunding a payout that was already a credit will double-credit the user. Consider restricting refund to debit-style txns (e.g., type in {registration_fee, order_purchase}).

KYC validation only checks length (12 digits / 10 chars). PAN format is technically `[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]` — current 'ABCDE1234F' passes, but '1234567890' would also pass. Tighten with regex if real KYC compliance matters.
/admin/users/{id}/wallet/freeze toggles state without idempotency — a double-tap from UI would unfreeze. Consider passing explicit `{frozen: bool}` payload.

rca_of_issue: RBAC bug: server.py:702 defines admin_update_settings with `_: ... = Depends(require_admin)`. The intended super-admin guard `require_admin_role` is implemented in server.py:142 but never wired up. Manager admin (role=admin, admin_role=manager) successfully PUT-updates settings — confirmed reproduction in TestRBAC. Mitigation: replace dependency with `Depends(require_admin_role('super_admin'))`. AdminHome spinner bug: admin/home.tsx:39-51 — load() catches all errors silently, then render gate `if (loading || !data) return <Spinner/>` traps the screen forever. Mitigation: track an `error` state, render an error UI with a Retry button, and only render spinner when actually loading.
